title: EvidenceFusion Event
description: Common event schema for normalized digital evidence used in DFIR investigations.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for the normalized event.

timestamp.description: Date and time when the event occurred.

source.description: Evidence source from which the event was obtained.

event_type.description: Type of activity represented by the event.

user.description: User associated with the event, if available.

host.description: Host or workstation associated with the event, if available.

source_ip.description: Source IP address associated with the event, if available.

destination_ip.description: Destination IP address associated with the event, if available.

domain.description: Domain associated with the event, if available.

artifact.description: Relevant digital artifact associated with the event.

hash.description: Cryptographic hash associated with the evidence, if available.

confidence.description: Confidence score assigned to the normalized event.
